quote: We conduct experiments across three diverse tasks: mathematical problem-solving, code generation, and chat.

We evaluate IMPART across three diverse tasks with various backbones... mathematics (GSM8K, MATH) using Pass@1 accuracy, code generation (HumanEval, MBPP) using Pass@1 accuracy, and chat (IFEval, AlpacaEval2) using respective metrics.

We evaluate on GSM8K  and MATH  using Pass@1 accuracy, focusing on complex mathematical reasoning abilities. Code Generation Performance is assessed on HumanEval  and MBPP  using Pass@1 accuracy for natural language to code generation. Chat Models are evaluated using IFEval  loose prompt metric for response controllability and AlpacaEval2  length-controlled win rate (LCWR) against GPT4-Turbo baseline, judged by GPT-4o-2024-08-06.
outputs: Generated code snippets for code generation and text responses for dialogue generation.
generated model responses for math problems, code snippets, and chat dialogues
The generated outputs include solutions to math problems, generated code from natural language descriptions, and chat responses to user prompts.
